title: Custom eggless cakes ready before work for Box Hill and Rouse Hill families
summary:
A cake collected at 6am doesn't mean a rushed order. It means the sponge, buttercream, and piping were finished the night before — which is why Riverstone opens weekdays at 6am, not 9am.

Families in Box Hill, Rouse Hill, and Vineyard order this way for early birthday drop-offs, office celebrations, and school run mornings — no need to take the afternoon off to collect a cake.

100% eggless. Six sizes, 15 flavours, buttercream, fondant, or ganache. 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. Free parking at Riverstone Shopping Centre.
